modalities.evidence: In vivo 7T MRI submillimeter dataset investigating the human cortex and hippocampus
anatomical MP2RAGE data and 8 + 6 functional runs were acquired at a resolution of 0.8 mm isotropic

output.summary: Submillimeter 7T MRI of human cortex and hippocampus during an associative learning task with predictable and unpredictable audiovisual sequences, including anatomical MP2RAGE and functional runs across two sessions.
